study_description: Representations of psychological experience — paranoia, psychosis, identity, memory, and altered states — as depicted in PKD's fiction, theorized in the Exegesis, and reconstructed by biographers and critics.

topics.card_description: Anamnesis as PKD's master concept: Platonic recollection reframed as divine remembering after 2-3-74.
